body_html:
Our design team starts with developing a complete understanding of our client’s goals before we start any project. This requires careful analysis of project needs, including budget, level of quality and function.  Once complete, this basic pre-design process becomes the foundation of decision making and project success.

Design success is not just about aesthetics, it must encompass function and commercial needs. Our pre-design and planning  process is unique. It is a process we follow that enables the entire team, from owner to consultants, to fully embrace the goals of the project and make decisions that will lead to a successful project outcome.

Using the latest industry design tools, our team quickly delivers concepts that are functional and memorable. We understand that design is place driven and develop options that respond to our region and culture.

Along with our traditional architectural design services, our team can assist clients to develop pre-design project deliverables including:

  • Feasibility Design Studies
  • Concept Studies
  • 3D Modeling and Video Fly-through
  • Character and Capacity Studies
